findings.highlight: Caster’s dagger wrenched open my back.
findings.evidenceJa: 背骨をスッパリと抉り切った
findings.governingReading: The dagger cleanly gouges and cuts through his spine.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the wound to an opened back and removes the explicit spinal damage that drives the later pain imagery.

findings.highlight: My body moves.
findings.evidenceJa: ひゅん、と大きく体が泳ぐ
findings.governingReading: His body swings or lurches broadly through the air with Saber’s leap.
findings.explanation: Moves discards the speed, loss of balance, and involuntary transport.

findings.highlight: having my back cut with scissors
findings.evidenceJa: 背骨をハサミでジョキジョキと切られて
findings.governingReading: having his spine repeatedly snipped with scissors
findings.explanation: The English again relocates the pain from the spine to the generic back and loses the repeated cutting sound.

findings.highlight: Nodding my head
findings.evidenceJa: 顔を下げたまま
findings.governingReading: Keeping his face lowered
findings.explanation: The English invents a nod and changes Shirou’s pain-constrained posture.

findings.highlight: They surround us.
findings.evidenceJa: 地面に膝をついた俺と、俺を守るように剣を構えるセイバーを取り囲んでいく
findings.governingReading: The bones close around Shirou on his knees and Saber holding her sword to guard him.
findings.explanation: The English removes the entire physical tableau that explains why Saber cannot attack Caster.

findings.highlight: I will be sure to defeat you with everything I have
findings.evidenceJa: 我が剣の全てを以って貴様を焼き尽くす
findings.governingReading: She will use the full power of her sword to burn Caster to ashes before disappearing.
findings.explanation: Defeat weakens both Saber’s promised method and the annihilating severity that coerces Caster into sparing Shirou.

findings.highlight: Even the bones around Caster are cowed
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターばかりか周囲の骨どもさえ威圧された
findings.governingReading: Not only Caster but even the surrounding bones are cowed.
findings.explanation: The English omits Caster herself as the primary target visibly intimidated by Saber.

findings.highlight: This is the only useless talk I will engage in.
findings.evidenceJa: くだらない無駄話はそこまでよ
findings.governingReading: Enough of this pointless chatter.
findings.explanation: The English reverses a command to end the digression into a declaration that this is the sole chatter she will permit.

findings.highlight: I can persuade it to be on my side
findings.evidenceJa: 捕えてしまえばどうとでも懐柔できる
findings.governingReading: Once captured, even the finest knight can be tamed or bent to her will by any means.
findings.explanation: Persuade sanitizes capture and coercive conditioning, while “it” introduces a grammatical and dehumanizing pronoun shift.

findings.highlight: My lacerated consciousness boils up.
findings.evidenceJa: 切れ切れになっていた意識が沸騰する
findings.governingReading: His fading, broken consciousness surges to a boil.
findings.explanation: Lacerated consciousness is a malformed physical calque and confuses his wound with his intermittent awareness.

findings.highlight: I kick the pain in my back aside and get up.
findings.evidenceJa: 感覚のない足で立ち上がる
findings.governingReading: He forces himself upright on legs without sensation.
findings.explanation: The English omits the disabling numbness that makes standing an act of extreme effort.

findings.highlight: Caster sounds delighted.
findings.evidenceJa: 嘲笑うキャスターの声
findings.governingReading: Caster’s voice openly mocks him.
findings.explanation: Delighted replaces hostile ridicule with pleasure and distorts her response to Shirou’s suicidal resistance.

findings.highlight: the axe into her pained head
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みを訴えようとする首を斧が
findings.governingReading: an axe drives into the neck that would cry out in brutal pain
findings.explanation: The English moves the axe’s target from Caster’s neck to her head and drops the personified attempt to voice pain.

findings.highlight: twists like a wave
findings.evidenceJa: 蛇のようにうねった
findings.governingReading: writhes like a snake
findings.explanation: The English replaces the predatory serpentine movement with a generic wave.

findings.highlight: each one of those weapons equals
findings.evidenceJa: 匹敵する魔剣、魔槍
findings.governingReading: Each is a demonic sword or spear comparable to a Servant’s Noble Phantasm.
findings.explanation: The English omits the weapon categories and generalizes the objects into Noble Phantasm equivalents.

findings.highlight: The merciless rain of Noble Phantasms.
findings.evidenceJa: 無尽蔵とも言える宝具の雨
findings.governingReading: a rain of Noble Phantasms that seems inexhaustible
findings.explanation: Merciless substitutes cruelty for the apparently limitless quantity driving Caster’s disbelief.

findings.highlight: her glare is different from before
findings.evidenceJa: 男を睨むその気迫は、今までの比ではなかった
findings.governingReading: The force in Saber’s glare is beyond anything she has shown before.
findings.explanation: Different removes the extreme intensity of Saber’s rejection.

findings.highlight: It is a strange hybrid this time.
findings.evidenceJa: 今回はまた変わり種だな
findings.governingReading: This one is another unusual variant.
findings.explanation: Hybrid adds a specific mixed-origin classification that the gold Archer has not stated.

findings.highlight: a stare prizing a possession
findings.evidenceJa: 自らの所有物を愛玩するだけの冷たい視線
findings.governingReading: a cold gaze that merely toys fondly with something it regards as its own property
findings.explanation: Prizing softens the dehumanizing combination of possession and self-serving fondling directed at Illya and Saber.

findings.highlight: You are the fifth one.
findings.evidenceJa: せっかくの五人目なのだからな
findings.governingReading: After all, she is the long-awaited or valuable fifth one.
findings.explanation: The English retains the number but removes the evaluative language marking Illya as another useful specimen or vessel.

findings.highlight: What kind of effect does it have?
findings.evidenceJa: それにどんな効果があったのか
findings.governingReading: Whatever effect those words had on Illya—
findings.explanation: The English changes a retrospective observation of an immediate effect into an abstract present-tense question.

findings.highlight: Be prepared
findings.evidenceJa: 心を決めておくがいい
findings.governingReading: Make up your mind before he next comes for her.
findings.explanation: Be prepared weakens the demand that Saber decide whether to accept his possessive claim.
